start.zielgruppeTitel: Who is the care assessment for?
start.zielgruppeText: Choose the option that applies so the right questionnaire starts:
start.erwachseneText: Standard assessment procedure (NBA) for people aged 18 and over.
start.kinderText: Special assessment that discounts the development normal for the child’s age.
start.rechtshinweis: This care level calculator offers mathematical guidance based on SGB XI. It does not replace a medical assessment or binding legal advice. Only the responsible care fund can make a legally effective classification.

m1_1.label: Can you get up and move about on your own?
m1_1.hilfe: Getting up from a bed or chair and moving around inside the home.

m1_2.label: Do you need help walking or standing?
m1_2.hilfe: Keeping your balance safely in a room.

m1_3.label: Can you climb stairs?
m1_3.hilfe: Managing steps, with a handrail if needed.

m1_4.label: Do you depend on a wheelchair?
m1_4.hilfe: Using one to get around in everyday life.

m2_1.label: Recognising people close to you
m2_1.hilfe: Are family members or neighbours identified without doubt?

m2_2.label: Orientation to place
m2_2.hilfe: Can the person find their way around their own home or familiar surroundings?

m2_3.label: Orientation to time
m2_3.hilfe: Can the time of day, day of the week and season be named correctly?

m2_4.label: Remembering important events
m2_4.hilfe: Are significant events or arrangements (e.g. doctor appointments) retained?

m2_5.label: Directing everyday activities
m2_5.hilfe: Can multi-step everyday activities be planned and carried out independently?

modul3.title: Module 3: Behaviour and mental health
modul3.weight: Weighting: 15% (compared with module 2 — the higher score counts)

m3_1.label: Motor-driven behaviour
m3_1.hilfe: E.g. aimless pacing, getting up and sitting down repeatedly, tendency to wander off.

m3_2.label: Restlessness at night
m3_2.hilfe: Is the day-night rhythm disturbed? Is there wandering or calling out at night?

m3_3.label: Self-harming and self-aggressive behaviour
m3_3.hilfe: E.g. scratching, striking objects, refusing food or fluids.

m3_4.label: Resistance to care
m3_4.hilfe: Is there verbal or physical resistance during personal hygiene or dressing?

modul4.title: Module 4: Self-care
modul4.weight: Weighting: 40% — the most important category in the assessment

m4_1.label: Washing the upper body and intimate area
m4_1.hilfe: Can you wash yourself at the basin or in the shower without help?

m4_2.label: Brushing teeth, combing hair, shaving
m4_2.hilfe: Can you carry out daily mouth and hair care yourself?

m4_3.label: Preparing food into bite-sized pieces and eating
m4_3.hilfe: Can you cut bread, bring food to your mouth, chew and swallow?

m4_4.label: Using a toilet or commode
m4_4.hilfe: Can you sit down, stand up, adjust your clothing and clean yourself?

m4_5.label: Dressing and undressing the upper body
m4_5.hilfe: Can you put on and take off shirts, jumpers or underwear on your own?

m4_6.label: Dressing and undressing the lower body
m4_6.hilfe: Can you put on trousers, socks and shoes without help?

modul5.title: Module 5: Coping with illness and treatment

m5_1.label: Medication
m5_1.hilfe: Can medication be taken independently, on time and at the right dose?

m5_2.label: Injections, infusions, suctioning
m5_2.hilfe: Can medical measures (e.g. insulin injections or measurements) be carried out independently?

m5_3.label: Doctor and therapy appointments
m5_3.hilfe: Can appointments be arranged and the journey to the practice managed independently?

m5_4.label: Following diets and restrictions
m5_4.hilfe: Can prescribed health requirements be followed independently in everyday life?

modul6.title: Module 6: Everyday life
modul6.weight: Legal context: safeguarding an SGB XI appeal
modul6.widerspruchText: This module does not change the calculated points directly, but it forms the legal basis for an appeal if the Medical Service recorded the care situation incompletely.
modul6.auswertungHinweis: When you start the evaluation, your data is calculated according to the SGB XI guidelines and compared with the state-specific relief amounts.
modul6.fussnote: © 2026 PflegeNavigator EU gUG • All calculations are based on the statutory thresholds of the Federal Ministry of Health.

m6_q1.label: 1. Who takes care of the housekeeping (cleaning, laundry)?

selbst.beschreibung: Carries out all cleaning tasks independently.

teilweise.beschreibung: Light tasks alone, heavier ones (e.g. curtains, vacuuming) with help.

nicht.beschreibung: The household is run entirely by relatives or services.

m6_q2.label: 2. How independently can everyday shopping be done?

ja.beschreibung: Visits shops alone and carries the goods home.

online_begleitung.beschreibung: Needs help carrying items or someone to come along to the shop.

nicht.beschreibung: Errands are handled entirely by others.

m6_q3.label: 3. Can hot and cold meals be prepared reliably?

selbst.beschreibung: Plans, cooks, serves and cleans the kitchen independently.

teilweise.beschreibung: Help needed with cutting, lifting heavy pots or organising the steps.

nicht.beschreibung: Meals have to be prepared or delivered ready to eat (meals on wheels).

m6_q4.label: 4. Are financial matters and dealings with authorities managed?

voll.beschreibung: Handles transfers, contracts, cash and post without errors.

teilweise.beschreibung: Needs help with complex forms or someone to keep track of deadlines.

nicht.beschreibung: Matters are handed over completely under a power of attorney.

m6_q5.label: 5. Can decisions about the future be made?

selbst.titel: Yes, entirely on their own responsibility
selbst.beschreibung: Makes medical and organisational decisions confidently and alone.

beratung.beschreibung: Weighs up options with relatives, but decides the essentials alone.

nicht.beschreibung: Needs a legal guardian or comprehensive help with decisions.

ergebnis.erklaerungTitel: How is my care level determined? (In plain terms)
ergebnis.erklaerungText: The law does not measure a care level in minutes or hours, but purely by how much independence in everyday life you retain. The assessment system awards points across the areas listed below. From 12.5 points you receive care level 1, from 27 points level 2, from 47.5 points level 3, from 70 points level 4, and from 90 points the highest level 5.
ergebnis.pflegegeldHinweis: For care provided privately by relatives
ergebnis.kombiRechner: Split benefits in kind (combined care calculator)
ergebnis.pg1Text: At care level 1 the fund does not yet pay a care allowance directly. You do, however, receive the full relief amount. It is earmarked and can be reimbursed for approved everyday companions, home help or day care.
ergebnis.pg0Text: With your calculated score of {punkte} points you currently fall below the statutory threshold of 12.5 points for a care level. Should your situation deteriorate in everyday life, it is worth repeating the assessment promptly with the new circumstances.
ergebnis.gdbText: You may be entitled to tax allowances and extra leave.
ergebnis.seitenUntertitel: Determined according to the official assessment guidelines
